name: Denton Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Denton Methodist Church. Open Tue and Fri 10am-2pm. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Tameside Council Allotments
short_description: Tameside Council allotment sites in Denton area
description: Council manages sites at Denton and Haughton. Plots from £35/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage.

name: Denton Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Denton Park. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Open weekends during growing season.
